title: Hollywood development measurements
author: Justin Fowler
scope: Author-run development tests on an Apple Silicon Mac Studio; not an independent benchmark or guarantee for other hardware.

video.memory_note: MLX allocation, not whole-machine physical RAM

review_program.method: Circular dissolves over selected short takes, with a synthesized soundtrack; repeated footage, not fresh real-time generation

qualification.browser: Desktop and mobile Chromium viewports, full playback and saved state

limitations: Fresh real-time 4K neural generation not qualified
No claim of sample-perfect network reconnection or invisible repetition
Public repository is an earlier source snapshot, not a turnkey version of this development build
